scope: iNaturalist ID overlap across three documented manifest sets only
limitations: The 99-gap manifest has metadata candidates, whereas the other two contain downloaded/decoded candidates. Counts are not additive approved training photos.
Observation IDs in the 99-gap manifest repeat within one source when multiple photos come from an observation.
This is exact ID matching and does not detect transformed/reposted images, same individual plant, attribution or licensing changes.
Earlier GBIF manifest comparison is reported separately; no new GBIF cross-check here.
No label, visual domain, or independent phone-photo audit is implied.
